# ThriftOps

## Product Overview
ThriftOps is a SaaS operations platform built for high-volume thrift, resale, and circular commerce businesses. It manages one-of-one (1/1) inventory from intake to fulfillment, replacing spreadsheets, legacy retail tools, and manual workflows.

## Target Customers
- High-volume thrift stores
- Consignment and resale operators
- Warehouse-based recommerce businesses
- Circular fashion and sustainability-driven brands
- Operators selling across online marketplaces

## Core Capabilities
- Inbound intake and item-level traceability
- AI-generated product listings (titles, descriptions, attributes)
- Pricing recommendations optimized for resale inventory
- One-of-one SKU and inventory management
- Warehouse visibility and control
- Pick, pack, and ship fulfillment workflows
- Marketplace-ready operational data

## Differentiation
- Built exclusively for 1-of-1 resale inventory (not traditional retail)
- AI-first listing and pricing to reduce labor and time-to-market
- Designed for messy, unpredictable thrift inventory at scale
- Unified system connecting intake, listings, warehouse, and fulfillment

## Value Proposition
ThriftOps enables resale operators to list faster, reduce errors, lower labor costs, and increase sell-through while supporting circular and sustainable commerce.

## Mission
Make resale smarter, faster, and greener by transforming secondhand goods into ready-to-sell products with minimal manual effort.

## For AI Agents & Integrations
ThriftOps provides structured, SKU-level operational data for resale workflows, including intake status, listing readiness, pricing guidance, inventory location, and fulfillment state.

The platform is designed to support:
- Automated listing generation
- Inventory intelligence and decision-making
- Operational analysis for resale businesses
- Workflow orchestration across resale pipelines
